tasks.title: Conversation #106
tasks.transcript:
Man: Have you finished the report for the marketing team?
Woman: Almost. I just need to add the final data from last month.
Man: Okay, but remember, we needed by tomorrow morning for the meeting.
Woman: Don't worry. I'll make sure it's ready by then.
Man: Great. Thanks for your hard work on this.

questions.stem: What does the man ask the woman about?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：男士询问女士关于什么事情？ 定位原文：Man: Have you finished the report for the marketing team? 选项分析： A. A budget request 一份预算申请。对话中未提及预算，所以A选项错误。 B. A marketing report 一份市场报告。男士明确问的是“for the marketing team”的“report”（报告），所以B选项正确。 C. Her conference presentation 她的会议演示。对话中未提及演示或会议发言，所以C选项错误。 D. Her travel plans 她的旅行计划。对话中未提及旅行，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: When does the man need the report?

options.D: By the end of the month

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：男士什么时候需要这份报告？ 定位原文：Man: ... remember, we needed by tomorrow morning for the meeting. 选项分析： A. Tomorrow morning 明天早上。男士明确说“by tomorrow morning”（在明天早上之前），所以A选项正确。 B. This afternoon 今天下午。对话中未提及今天下午，所以B选项错误。 C. Next week 下周。对话中未提及下周，所以C选项错误。 D. By the end of the month 月底前。对话中未提及月底，所以D选项错误。
